name: s3.cdn
title: Field: s3.cdn
description: Meaning of the CDN URL returned together with a pre-signed upload target.
meaning: Stable CDN URL that should be passed into user.uploadCreate after the external upload succeeds.
text:
# s3.cdn

TL;DR:
- s3.cdn is the value for user.uploadCreate after the PUT upload succeeds. It is still not the upload id.
